config_upernet_xcit_small: configure UperNet with XCiT-Small backbone (patch_size=8, embed_dim=384, depth=12) for ADE20K semantic segmentation
configure_xcit_backbone: configure XCiT backbone with patch_size=8, embed_dim=384, depth=12, num_heads=8, and out_indices=[3,5,7,11]
configure_decode_head: configure UperNet decode head with in_channels=[384,384,384,384] and 150 classes for ADE20K segmentation
configure_optimizer_adamw: configure AdamW optimizer with lr=0.00006, weight_decay=0.01, and zero weight decay for position embeddings and norms
configure_lr_schedule: configure poly learning rate schedule with linear warmup over 1500 iterations and warmup_ratio=1e-6
